messages.author: 419a40da673a6664
messages.subject: Export Besag results.
parts:
Hello,
I want to export the results of a BYM model so that I can plot them using QGIS. I computed the neighbors list using spdep::poly2nb. Can I just simply cbind summary.fitted.values to the data frame in the data slot of the original spatial polygons data frame? Or is the order not the same? 

Thank you,
Bernardo

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Export Besag results.
parts:
Hi,
The .fitted.values output is in the same order as the data points provided to inla(), which may or may not be in the same order as your graph nodes; it depends on how your data.frame was defined.

Finn
